Answers that we believe must be heard. Frequently asked questions Anti Dandruff & Hairfall Kit Can I use this Hair Growth Serum Roll-On more than once a day? Yes, If one can, should do. However, once a day is compulsory for noticeable results, non-compliance to daily usage may delay the process of new hair growth. Will there be any side effects of using this hair growth serum roll-on? No, there are no side-effects. Its 100% Safe & Plant- Based Serum. Is it pregnancy/breastfeeding safe? Our Hair Growth Serum Roll On is completely safe for pregnant and breastfeeding women. But it is recommended to visit your doctor to check for allergies prior to usage. Will this shampoo completely cure dandruff? No shampoo can permanently cure dandruff, but ingredients like ZPTO, Piroctone Olamine, Climbazole & Salicylic Acid significantly reduce flakes and control recurrence with regular use. Does it dry out the scalp? No, it contains ingredients like Erythritol, Pentavitin, and Allantoin to keep the scalp moisturized. How long before I see results? Visible reduction in flakes may be seen within 1 week of consistent use.
